# Doug Rosenberg

> Chicago-based saxophonist, composer, and educator. Debut album *Better Than TV* (2014); co-leader of Eastern Blok (*Underwater*, *Folk Tales*) and the Goran Ivanovic Group. Performed with Robert Glasper, Rakalam Bob Moses, Kendrick Scott, Danilo Pérez, Fareed Haque, and others.

"Fearlessness of spirit and a robustness of tone that seem likely to win him a devoted following." — Chicago Tribune

## Background
- Recordings: *Better Than TV* (2014 debut), Goran Ivanovic Group, Eastern Blok's *Underwater* and *Folk Tales*
- Performance: Chicago venues including Millennium Park, Green Mill, Symphony Center, and the Jazz Showcase; national/international venues including Joe's Pub, Blues Alley, and the Canadian Guitar Festival
- Guest artist / visiting instructor at Princeton, Cornell, Carnegie Mellon, University of Michigan, and other universities and schools
- Teaching: private instruction across Chicago-area schools; former New Trier High School jazz improvisation and saxophone instructor (2003–2011)
- Education: New England Conservatory, Bachelor of Music in Jazz Performance
- Member, International Association of Jazz Educators; endorsed by Selmer Saxophones
